mission_assessment.rev0694_focus: separate lease expiry from retry readiness so a crashed transfer claim can cool down deterministically before reclaim or abandon

audit_refactor_target: shared resume-transfer workorder claim/probe/reclaim/abandon helper and companion event schemas
audit_findings: Rev0693 correctly preserved reclaim and abandon history, but expiry and retry readiness were still represented by a single lease predicate.
Under-cap expired rows could be reclaimed immediately at every lease boundary, which is safe but creates daemon churn rather than scheduler policy.
The helper was already centralized enough to add retry-at gating without widening the filesystem mutation surface.
behavioral_invariants_added: retry_at_epoch is computed as lease_expires_at_epoch + workorder_retry_backoff_seconds * claim_attempt
with zero backoff, retry_at_epoch equals lease_expires_at_epoch to preserve rev0693 behavior
expired rows fail closed before retry_at_epoch opens
reclaim and abandon SQL updates are gated by retry_at_epoch <= workorder_claim_now_epoch
reclaim events persist both previous and new retry-at epochs
abandon events persist the previous retry-at epoch
